description.value:
You house the dead who never really left their posts — factory hands, rail conductors, gunnery crews, the countless souls the pre-Turning war machine wired directly into its equipment and then simply forgot to unwire when they died. They're calm, competent, and think in schematics.

  • In Quiet, machine-spirits read as legible to you — the condition, mood, and last few commands of a piece of ghost-machinery come through like a technician reading a gauge.
  • Dead Hand's Grip: Unveiled, you can activate a nearby machine — friendly or hostile — making it perform a function for you, or seizing a hostile one in place for a round.
  • Lowest average Toll growth of the three Covenants; a Ghost-Static spirit forgives an honest ask. It just never forgives a dishonest one.
